Messages.Author: ira...@gmail.com
Messages.Body:
Hello All,

What's the best way to search this newsgroup, now that Google is
restricting searches to the recent past?

I wanted to know what happens if a minion uses a zip gun, the opposing
minion uses S:CE (strike: Combat Ends), and then a minion uses
Telepathic Tracking. What happens to the self-inflicted damage from
the zip gun in round 1, or in round 2?

Thanks,
Ira

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
ira...@gmail.com wrote:
> Hello All,
>
> What's the best way to search this newsgroup, now that Google is
> restricting searches to the recent past?

Google.

Use the "search all groups" button, but include "groups:rec.*.jyhad" in your
search terms. That *seems* to lift the restriction.

> I wanted to know what happens if a minion uses a zip gun, the opposing
> minion uses S:CE (strike: Combat Ends), and then a minion uses
> Telepathic Tracking. What happens to the self-inflicted damage from
> the zip gun in round 1, or in round 2?

Zip Gun hasn't yet been used.

If it is used in the second round, then it will deal its damage to the bearer as
normal.

Messages.Author: John Whelan
Messages.Body:
On Aug 25, 8:05 pm, "ira...@gmail.com" <ira...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Hello All,
>
> What's the best way to search this newsgroup, now that Google is
> restricting searches to the recent past?

If you are on this page...

http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/topics

... and you enter your search terms next to the “search this group”
button, you will for some reason get only recent results.

I am not aware of problems searching via any other route. For
instance, “search groups” on the same page yields unrestricted
results.

Also, if you go to this page (the basic google-groups page):

http://groups.google.com /

and click on “advanced groups search” thereby arriving at this page:

http://groups.google.com/advanced_search?q=&

and enter whatever search criteria you desire (ie. Author: LSJ; and/or
Group: rec.*.jyhad), you should get unrestricted results.
